description: Tucked into the heart of San Francisco's beloved Inner Richmond District, this beautifully renovated TIC (Tenancy in Common) blends classic charm with modern upgrades an increasingly rare find in today's competitive market. 525 (Upper Unit) is a spacious two-level residence designed for both functionality and style. The main level features a generous living room, formal dining area, one bedroom, and a full bath. The large kitchen with center island anchors the home, complemented by a dedicated washer and dryer room. Step out onto the private deck overlooking the lush yardperfect for morning coffee or evening unwinding. Upstairs, you'll find two expansive bedrooms with impressive walk-in closets outfitted with modern shelving, a full bath, and a versatile office nook for work-from-home ease.The space has been thoughtfully updated with engineered flooring, recessed lighting, and modernized systems throughout. Additional improvements include tankless water heaters and fresh interior and exterior paint, offering a turnkey opportunity for owner occupants. Location is everything and the Inner Richmond delivers. Positioned just minutes from Golden Gate Park, residents enjoy unparalleled access to green space, museums, and outdoor recreation. Clement Street's vibrant corridor offers a dynamic mix of acclaimed dining, local markets, and everyday conveniences, while Geary Boulevard provides excellent public transit options for easy commuting across the city.
